title: Interview with Ravi
summary: Tomas interviewed Ravi, a researcher, in a research interview.

qa_highlights.question: What would you tell someone just starting out?
qa_highlights.answer: Write down what you tried even when it fails

qa_highlights.question: How did you pay for the first year?
qa_highlights.answer: A small grant covered the equipment and weekend consulting paid for the rest

qa_highlights.question: How did the project start?
qa_highlights.answer: The team noticed the sensors drifted every winter and nobody had measured it before

qa_highlights.question: How big was the team at the beginning?
qa_highlights.answer: Three people in a rented garage sharing a single laptop

quotes.speaker: Ravi
quotes.text: Failed experiments teach you the most.
